hero.description: Explore the first isometric chess metaverse. Create your pixel-art avatar, decorate your room and learn from grandmasters in real-time inside the game.

classroom.title: VIRTUAL CLASSROOMS

fast_match.title: PIXEL-ART AVATARS

wallet.title: INTERACTIVE FURNITURE

data.title: TANGIBLE PROGRESS

verified.title: SPATIAL CHAT

dark_glass.title: STATE OF THE ART
dark_glass.desc: The entire metaverse is coated with our acclaimed liquid-glass UI engine, dark, smooth and visually soothing.
